items.title: Microsoft plans locked-down Copilot Chat mode for Study and Learn
items.summary: Microsoft is preparing an IT-controlled mode that locks Copilot Chat to the Study and Learn Agent, designed for educational settings. Students would not be able to switch to general Copilot Chat or other agents, while still being able to add their own files as references.

items.title: GitHub security risk assessments now show repository protection status
items.summary: GitHub’s code security and secret risk assessments now indicate whether findings are in protected or unprotected repositories, helping organizations spot where to extend security coverage. The improvement is available in GitHub Enterprise Cloud and GitHub Team; secret risk assessment support is slated for GitHub Enterprise Server 3.24.

items.title: GitHub Agentic Workflows weekly update highlights hardening and cost-aware routing
items.summary: GitHub’s November 2 Agentic Workflows roundup describes safer pull-request outputs, optional actions-lock integration, guided remediation, and additional workflows adopting model routing to keep lower-cost work economical. The post reports these project updates and notes that release v1.0.1 itself was published October 27.

items.title: OpenAI launches Grid Protectors program to support strained power grids
items.summary: OpenAI launched Grid Protectors, a national program to work with utilities, regulators, and policymakers on reducing electricity demand at its future campuses during periods of grid strain. In Georgia, the company says its planned Effingham County campus agreement includes up to 1,000 megawatts of flexible demand response; additional arrangements will vary by location.

items.title: OpenAI signs Abu Dhabi agreements on AI investment and UAE-wide adoption
items.summary: Abu Dhabi announced new agreements involving OpenAI, including an AI investment-analysis arrangement with Mubadala and Inception42, and a five-year agreement with Inception42 to support frontier AI adoption across government, enterprise, and education. The announcement signals a wider regional expansion of OpenAI’s institutional partnerships beyond the separate ADNOC energy deal.

items.title: ADNOC partners with OpenAI and G42 to deploy Frontier across its energy operations
items.summary: ADNOC, OpenAI, and G42 announced a multi-year partnership to deploy OpenAI Frontier across ADNOC’s energy operations, making ADNOC the first energy company to deploy the platform. The partners plan to combine OpenAI models with ADNOC’s industrial data on G42’s sovereign UAE infrastructure to support planning and connected business decisions, with human experts overseeing consequential decisions.

items.title: Omen AI acquires Aquatic Labs for $16 million to advance data-center cooling
items.summary: Omen AI announced a $16 million cash-and-stock acquisition of Aquatic Labs, adding its sensor research and expertise to Omen’s AI data-center cooling systems. The companies plan to combine fluid-monitoring capabilities to help operators detect cooling problems earlier and reduce disruption.

items.title: Grok Bot usage limits tightened amid high operating costs
items.summary: Grok Bot users reported reaching usage limits sooner, and Elon Musk said the cost of serving the AI agent was “unsustainably high relative to revenue.” The episode points to the operational and commercial costs of running always-on agents, though the exact changes to limits were not detailed in the cited report.

items.title: 42AI emerges from stealth with $62.5 million for behavioral world model
items.summary: Israeli startup 42AI came out of stealth with $62.5 million in seed funding to develop a model intended to predict human behavior. The company says its system is already being used at some financial brokerages, though its performance claims remain early-stage and company-reported.

items.title: SemiAnalysis launches GDPx benchmark for agentic AI capabilities
items.summary: SemiAnalysis introduced GDPx, a benchmark for agentic capabilities across domains including software engineering, finance, law, biology, and chip design. The release adds a new evaluation framework for comparing AI agents on high-value professional work.

items.title: OpenAI merges ChatGPT’s Chat and Work tabs while sharing usage allowance with Codex
items.summary: OpenAI is merging ChatGPT’s Chat and Work tabs and moving ChatGPT and Codex to a shared token allowance pool, while keeping Codex separate in the desktop app. The change may affect how often some users need to wait for usage resets.
